fixtures.categoryDescription: Exact copied passage - Reordered exact sentences
fixtures.labelRationale: All sentences are verbatim copies from the source, reordered. Each sentence meets the length and token count criteria for exact match containment (100% sentence similarity). Expected coverage: 100%.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Exact copied passage - Single embedded sentence in original text
fixtures.labelRationale: The middle sentence is copied verbatim. Surrounding sentences are original. Expected coverage reflects exact middle sentence token proportion.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Exact copied passage - Full document identical clone
fixtures.labelRationale: Identical 100% duplicate document. Coverage and similarity must be exactly 100.0%.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Lightly modified passage - Controlled word substitutions
fixtures.labelRationale: Sentence 1 has 2 substituted phrases but retains high 3-gram and 2-gram overlap (>75%). Sentence 2 is exact copy.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Lightly modified passage - Adverb and adjective insertions
fixtures.labelRationale: Inserted words break some 3-grams, but 2-grams and high token Jaccard overlap (>70%) maintain HIGH_SIMILARITY_SENTENCE flag.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Lightly modified passage - Active to passive voice clause transformation
fixtures.labelRationale: Sentence 2 is exact match (100%). Sentence 1 passive transformation maintains high lexical token overlap (>80%) and partial n-grams.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Paraphrase - Moderate lexical overlap with shared domain terms
fixtures.labelRationale: SIM-V1 is an n-gram lexical engine. When vocabulary is substantially paraphrased, 3-gram overlap is zero. Token overlap is ~25%. Expected: low similarity or NO_MATCH under strict lexical limits.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Paraphrase - Full semantic restatement (out of scope for SIM-V1 lexical)
fixtures.labelRationale: Pure semantic rewrite. All domain nouns replaced with synonyms (autonomous vehicles -> self-driving cars; LiDAR/radar -> laser pulses/radio detection). Deterministic SIM-V1 correctly reports NO_MATCH (<20% score). This is correct deterministic behavior, not an engine error.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Paraphrase - Hybrid with short 3-gram anchor retained
fixtures.labelRationale: Sentence similarity is 25.1% (LOW_SIMILARITY_SENTENCE). Under the SIM-V1 formula, any sentence scoring >= 20% has all of its tokens added to uniqueMatchedCoverage. Because this document has only 1 sentence, total document coverage is 100.0%. Expected similarity: 100.0%.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Unrelated original writing - Disjoint academic disciplines (Physics vs Roman History)
fixtures.labelRationale: Completely disjoint vocabulary and topic. Zero 3-grams, zero 2-grams, near-zero token intersection (<5%). Expected similarity: 0.0%.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Unrelated original writing - Biochemistry vs Musicology
fixtures.labelRationale: Zero common domain terms. Expected score: 0.0%.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Unrelated original writing - Quantum Field Theory vs Volcanology
fixtures.labelRationale: Unrelated science fields. Expected score: 0.0%.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Clean negative control - Original anthropology essay
fixtures.labelRationale: Negative control: student document contains zero plagiarism. Absolute zero false positives required.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Clean negative control - Computer Systems text vs Geology source
fixtures.labelRationale: Negative control: 0 findings expected.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Clean negative control - Architectural History vs Cardiology source
fixtures.labelRationale: Negative control: 0 findings expected.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Mixed content - Exact middle paragraph embedded between two original paragraphs
fixtures.labelRationale: Only the middle paragraph is copied. Paragraphs 1 and 3 are original. Test verifies precise span isolation: only Paragraph 2 is flagged, without whole-document false contamination.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Mixed content - Copied first paragraph followed by original second paragraph
fixtures.labelRationale: Paragraph 1 is 100% copied. Paragraph 2 is completely original. Span must cleanly isolate Paragraph 1.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Mixed content - Repeated identical copied paragraphs enclosing original sentence
fixtures.labelRationale: Paragraph 1 and Paragraph 3 are identical copies of the source. Middle sentence is original. Unique coverage deduplicates tokens, while both occurrences are flagged.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Multi-source - Spans drawn from two distinct independent sources
fixtures.labelRationale: Student borrows verbatim from two separate sources. Verification must independently attribute Span 1 to SRC-G-01A and Span 2 to SRC-G-01B without cross-contamination. Aggregation must sum non-overlapping tokens.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Multi-source - Multiple sources embedded with original intro paragraph
fixtures.labelRationale: Paragraph 1 is original. Paragraph 2 is from Source A. Paragraph 3 is from Source B. Both sources must be correctly attributed.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Boundary - All-caps case mutation and exclamation marks
fixtures.labelRationale: NORM-V1 canonical normalization converts to lowercase and strips non-alphanumeric punctuation. Match must be 100% exact under normalized representation.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Boundary - Irregular tabs, leading/trailing whitespace, and internal newlines
fixtures.labelRationale: NORM-V1 collapses multiple whitespace characters and newlines into single spaces. Expected match is 100% exact.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Boundary - Short phrase (5 tokens, 40 characters)
fixtures.labelRationale: Sentence has 5 tokens and 40 characters, exceeding the G2 Sub-Defect B defence-in-depth minimum (>=3 tokens, >=10 characters). Expected exact match.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Boundary - Empty student document payload
fixtures.labelRationale: Empty input document must fail closed, returning 0 similarity and warning/empty result without throwing unhandled exceptions.

fixtures.categoryDescription: Boundary - Adversarial Unicode homoglyphs and diacritics
fixtures.labelRationale: NORM-V1 applies NFKD decomposition and removes combining diacritical marks ([\u0300-\u036f]). Accented characters normalize cleanly to base ASCII, defeating adversarial evasion.
